headline: Community
body: Helpful starting points for players, parents, coaches, and referees across the West. Explore state associations, city programs, coaching education, and financial assistance. No Soccer Center account needed.
datasetNote: Resource links compiled October 2026. Program offerings, fees, eligibility, and deadlines can change; check the linked provider for current details. External course enrollment, program registration, or assistance applications may require an account. Links open in a new tab.

inclusiveSoccer.sectionDescription: Adaptive and unified soccer programs across the West — for players of all abilities.

unified.label: Unified Soccer
unified.description: Players with and without intellectual disabilities train and play together.

power.label: Power Wheelchair Soccer
power.description: Soccer adapted for athletes who use power wheelchairs.

blind.label: Blind and Visually Impaired Soccer
blind.description: Soccer adapted for players with vision impairments, using audible balls and adapted communication.

listings.name: Special Olympics Colorado — Unified Sports
listings.description: Players with and without intellectual disabilities train and play together through Special Olympics Colorado's Unified Sports program. Contact the state office to find a local soccer opportunity near you.

listings.name: Colorado Rolling Rapids
listings.description: A local power wheelchair soccer program serving the Denver metro area. Visit the website or reach out to confirm current practice schedules and participation arrangements.

listings.name: U.S. Association of Blind Athletes — Soccer Development Program
listings.description: National resource — ask about local opportunities. USABA's soccer development program can help connect you with blind and visually impaired soccer opportunities. A previous clinic was held at Colorado School for the Deaf and the Blind; contact USABA to ask about current Colorado programming.
listings.adminNote: CSDB clinic documented at https://csdb.colorado.gov/blind-soccer-usaba-and-switchbacks-clinic — previous clinic only, not a verified ongoing program. Kept in national referral until current programming is confirmed.

listings.name: Special Olympics Arizona — AIA Unified Sports
listings.description: School-based pathway including soccer, run through Special Olympics Arizona's AIA Unified Sports program. Players with and without intellectual disabilities participate together.

listings.name: Ability360 United / Ability360 Phoenix Rising
listings.description: Power wheelchair soccer program based in Phoenix. Visit the program page or contact the team to confirm current participation arrangements.

listings.name: Arizona Heat
listings.description: Power wheelchair soccer team based in Mesa. Listed in the US Power Soccer Association team directory. Contact to confirm current practice arrangements.

listings.name: U.S. Association of Blind Athletes — Soccer Development Program
listings.description: National resource — ask about local opportunities. No current Arizona blind soccer program has been verified. Contact USABA to ask about opportunities in your area.

listings.name: Special Olympics Southern California — Unified Sports
listings.description: Regional Unified Sports referral pathway for players with and without intellectual disabilities. Confirm soccer availability with your local program or participating school.

listings.name: LA Angels PFC
listings.description: Adaptive power wheelchair soccer team based in Los Angeles. Listed in the US Power Soccer Association team directory. Contact to confirm practice locations and participation details.

listings.name: LA Galaxy PSC
listings.description: Adaptive power wheelchair soccer team in Lakewood. Listed in the US Power Soccer Association team directory. Contact to confirm practice locations and participation details.

listings.name: Los Angeles Football Club (LAFC) Power Soccer
listings.description: Adaptive power wheelchair soccer program affiliated with LAFC, based in Norco. Listed in the US Power Soccer Association team directory. Contact to confirm practice locations and participation details.

listings.name: City of Los Angeles — PlayLA Adaptive Sports
listings.description: Los Angeles blind and visually impaired soccer pathway through the City of LA's PlayLA Adaptive Sports program. Clinic eligibility has included ages 5–17; verify the current offering before registering. Do not rely on past clinic dates.

listings.name: U.S. Association of Blind Athletes — Soccer Development Program
listings.description: National resource — ask about local opportunities. Use USABA's soccer development program directory to find blind and visually impaired soccer opportunities in Southern California.

listings.name: Special Olympics Northern California — Unified Leagues
listings.description: School-based Unified Sports pathway including soccer, through Special Olympics Northern California. Players with and without intellectual disabilities participate together.
listings.adminNote: sonc.org is Special Olympics Northern California. Do not confuse with sonc.net (Special Olympics North Carolina).

listings.name: BORP Adaptive Sports — Power Soccer
listings.description: Mixed-gender power wheelchair soccer program based in Berkeley, serving the Bay Area. Open to participants across ages. Contact BORP to confirm current schedule and participation.

listings.name: San Jose Power Soccer (Flash & Steamrollers)
listings.description: San Jose Power Soccer includes the San Jose Flash and San Jose Steamrollers. Visit the website to learn about both teams and current participation opportunities.

listings.name: Golden State Ducks
listings.description: Power wheelchair soccer team based in San Francisco. Listed in the US Power Soccer Association team directory. Contact to confirm current practice arrangements.

listings.name: U.S. Association of Blind Athletes — Soccer Development Program
listings.description: National resource — ask about local opportunities. No current Northern California blind soccer program has been verified. Contact USABA to ask about opportunities in your area.

listings.name: Special Olympics Oregon — Unified Sports
listings.description: Special Olympics Oregon lists Unified Soccer as a fall school sport. Contact the state office to find a local program near you.

listings.name: Bend FC — Unified Soccer
listings.description: Youth summer Unified Soccer program run by Bend FC Timbers in partnership with Special Olympics. Published 2026 sessions are past — contact the provider for the next season.
listings.adminNote: Published 2026 sessions are past. Do not display as upcoming.

listings.name: Rose City Renegades
listings.description: Power wheelchair soccer team based in Sherwood, Oregon. Listed in the US Power Soccer Association team directory. Contact to confirm current practice arrangements.

listings.name: U.S. Association of Blind Athletes — Soccer Development Program
listings.description: National resource — ask about local opportunities. No current Oregon blind soccer program has been verified. Contact USABA to ask about opportunities in your area.

listings.name: Special Olympics Washington — Unified Sports
listings.description: School and community referral pathways for Unified Sports in Washington. Confirm soccer availability for your location.

listings.name: US Power Soccer Association — Team Finder
listings.description: National resource — ask about local opportunities. No current Washington power soccer team has been verified. Use the USPSA team finder to search for programs near you.

listings.name: U.S. Association of Blind Athletes — Soccer Development Program
listings.description: National resource — ask about local opportunities. No current Washington blind soccer program has been verified. A Seattle FIFA World Cup 26 blind soccer clinic was listed as a program-development lead; contact USABA to ask about ongoing local availability.
listings.adminNote: Seattle FWC26 blind soccer clinic at https://www.seattlefwc26.org/events/blind-soccer-clinic is a program-development lead, not a verified ongoing club. Keep as national referral until confirmed.

listings.description: School-based soccer training through Special Olympics Nevada's Unified Sports program. Contact the state office to find a local opportunity.
